title: Plate Cell – SELEX Protocol
author: Claudia Troncone Clemente
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8sehwbe
materials: SELEX INITIAL ROUND: Exposure and Screening

steps.title: Prepare E. coli cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend E. coli cells in 1 mL of LB liquid medium and incubate overnight at 37 °C with constant shaking at 180 rpm in an incubator-shaker.

steps.title: Functionalize microtiter plate with PBA
steps.instruction: Coat a sterile microtiter plate with 100 μl of 2.5 mM PBA prepared in carbonate buffer (pH 9.2) and incubate overnight at 4 ºC.

steps.title: Prepare ssDNA library
steps.instruction: Prepare the single stranded DNA library to allow oligos to take 3D conformations.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 μL of 100 uM ssDNA library to 190 ul of binding buffer.
Incubate at 95 °C for 10 min.
Transfer immediately to ice-bath to prevent rehybridization (reheat for another 10 min and repeat if transfer was poor).
Incubate the tube at 4 °C overnight in the refrigerator.

steps.title: Culture bacteria to log-phase
steps.instruction: Grow the E. coli inoculum to the required density and subculture to log-phase.

substeps.instruction: Measure growth of the inoculum using a spectrophotometer at λ = 600 nm; ensure O.D. is ≥ 1.
Inoculate 250 μL of bacteria into 25 ml LB media (using 1% O.D. as inoculum).
Incubate at 37 ºC and 180 rpm for 1.5h until the culture reaches an O.D. between 0.5 – 0.6.

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells
steps.instruction: Isolate and clean the bacterial cells.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 3000 X g for 10 minutes.
Remove supernatant and wash cells 3 times with PBS (10 mM, pH 7.4).
Measure O.D. at λ = 600 nm; ensure O.D. is ≥ 1 (approximately 1 x 10^8 E. coli cells diluted in PBS). Adjust further with PBS if necessary.

steps.title: Coat plate with cells
steps.instruction: Attach the bacterial cells to the functionalized plate surface.

substeps.instruction: Wash the PBA coated plate 2 times with carbonate buffer.
Resuspend 100 μL of 1 x 10^3 cells in well #1.
Incubate at 25 ºC for 1h.
Decant the suspension by inversion and wash the well 3 times with 200 μL of Binding buffer.

steps.title: Incubate library with cells
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA library to the cell-coated surface.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 200 μL of naïve library (prepared previously) at 37 ºC for 15 minutes.
Gently add 200 μL of library to the cell coated well and incubate at 37 ºC for 1h.
Decant the solution from the plate by inverting.
Wash 3 times with 200 ul of Binding buffer to remove loosely bound sequences.

steps.title: Elute and neutralize DNA
steps.instruction: Recover the bound DNA sequences and stabilize the pH.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μL of elution buffer to the well and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Remove the solution using a micropipette, avoiding the walls.
Immediately neutralize by adding 10 μL of neutralization buffer to bring pH to ~7.

steps.title: Quantify and store sequences
steps.instruction: Measure the recovered DNA and store for future use.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge DNA elutes at 3,000 x g for 10 min to avoid bacterial contamination, then collect the supernatant.
Quantify the sequences with a spectrophotometer and label as Round #1.
Store at -20 °C until further use.
